readout: p = sigmoid(plume_logits); pp = avg_pool2d(p, 2) (20 m); scene_score = max(pp); plume_present = scene_score >= scene_threshold; mask = (pp >= mask_threshold) if plume_present else empty
note: threshold (0.5) is the legacy single pixel threshold. Scene thresholds were chosen on 2021 val plume-free pairs only; they are for scene_score (max of pooled probabilities), not for single pixels.
